title: Initialize reader binary, config loader, and connection acceptor
description:
Create usenet-ipfs-reader/src/main.rs. Parse TOML config. Initialize tokio runtime. Accept TCP connections, spawn one task per session. Shutdown on SIGTERM after draining active sessions (max 30s). Artifact: compilable reader binary.

Acceptance:
- cargo build -p usenet-ipfs-reader succeeds
- Accepts multiple simultaneous connections (test with 10 concurrent slrn processes)
- SIGTERM causes clean shutdown; active sessions are allowed to finish current command
- Config: listen_addr, max_connections, tls_cert, auth_required
